structured_output.what_is_happening: BELUGA, a Beluga-cat meme coin launched on pump.fun, is now on a PumpSwap pair (GMGN shows the same created and migrated timestamp). It is about 37 minutes old at $165k market cap with $35.7k liquidity. It has done $410k in volume in its first hour. The transaction mix is extreme: 8,318 buys against 808 sells, and 6,206 unique buyers against 397 unique sellers. The average buy is about $49. Holders number about 6,000, and the top 10 hold only 2.3% excluding the pool. The price peaked near $394k market cap and is now about 58% below that peak, down 27% in the last 5 minutes (GeckoTerminal: -9%). Mint and freeze authority are renounced and the LP is burned. The creator holds nothing, has closed out, and the coin is flagged as a community takeover.

narrative.description: Beluga cat is an old internet meme, a recognizable but well-worn subject. The packet's only project links are a generic .lol website and an X account with no rename history. The description is boilerplate 'meme energy, community vibes' text.
narrative.why_spreading: There is no visible organic driver. The activity pattern (thousands of small buys, very few sellers, near-perfectly flat holder distribution) fits volume or holder-farming bots better than viral human attention. The price has already topped and is falling off its peak.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is by far the most active Beluga token right now, with the only real volume and liquidity among the same-name tokens.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several dead BELUGA/beluga tokens, including 'Beluga Cat' E63C... from 2024 ($23.8k mcap, no volume) and a copycat 5pyE... launched about 3 minutes after this pair, with zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer-to-seller ratio is about 15:1 across 6,206 unique buyers in 1 hour, with small average buys. That is atypical for organic traffic on a coin that has already fallen 58% from its peak: real traders would be selling. The spread of about 6,000 holders with no holder above 0.27% looks like distribution to many farmed wallets. GMGN counts 23 bundler wallets and 11 snipers, and graph analysis finds an insider transfer network of 6 wallets. Only 8 GMGN page visits despite $410k volume suggests little human attention. The creator has already closed out.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X or Telegram data. A real community takeover or a KOL call could explain the many small buyers, and GMGN bot/degen rates are low.

structural_risks: Price is already 58% below its peak and falling at the moment of detection
Buy activity looks bot-inflated; once it stops, the real bid may be thin
$35k liquidity against $165k market cap allows sharp drops
The dev has exited and the coin is a CTO, so there is no committed team
A double means about $330k, close to the earlier peak where holders will sell

structured_output.counterargument: The LP is burned, authorities are renounced, there are no concentrated holders and the dev holds nothing, so there is no single wallet that can rug. Thousands of distinct buyers could be real retail interest in a recognizable meme. A CTO with a website and an X account can mount a second leg back to the earlier $394k peak, which would be a double from the lows. Coins like this sometimes bounce hard after a 60% drawdown.
